Aus Kitchen Pro.note: Aus Kitchen Pro operates as an independent Australian-based commercial kitchen equipment specialist established in 2013.

Carpigiani Horeca S.r.l..note: Carpigiani Horeca S.r.l., which manufactures the GBG slush and soft ice cream brand, operates as a subsidiary under the Carpigiani Group within the Ali Group.

Diamond Engineering Works.note: Diamond Engineering Works is an independent manufacturer of ice cream plants and softy machines based in Uttar Pradesh, India, founded in 1993.

Frost Master Private Limited.note: Frost Master Private Limited is an independent commercial refrigeration and kitchen equipment manufacturer established in Delhi, India, in 2021.

Guangdong Heavybao Commercial Kitchenwar.note: Guangdong Heavybao Commercial Kitchenware Co., Ltd. operates as an independent Chinese manufacturer and supplier of commercial kitchenware and catering equipment.

Guangzhou Prince Western Kitchen Equipme.note: Guangzhou Prince Western Kitchen Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates independently as a manufacturer of catering equipment and ice cream machines established in 2006.

Huasheng Refrigeration Equipment Manufac.note: Huasheng Refrigeration Equipment Factory operates independently as a Chinese manufacturer of soft serve ice cream machines established in 1999.

Jiangmen Gongly Machinery Co., Ltd..note: Jiangmen Gongly Machinery Co., Ltd. operates as an independent manufacturer of direct commercial refrigeration equipment established in 1999.

Kvr Industries.note: Kvr Industries is an independent Hyderabad-based manufacturer of commercial food equipment, including soft-serve ice cream machines, and has no verifiable record of being acquired.

Nimesh Innovations.note: Nimesh Innovations is an independent proprietary manufacturer and exporter of commercial kitchen and ice cream machinery based in Gujarat, India.

Rasa Royal.note: Rasa Royal operates as a trade name and brand of RR Retail Sdn Bhd and remains active with no record of an acquisition.

Sheeba Equipments.note: Sheeba Equipments is an independent proprietorship firm owned and led by CEO Anees Khan (Anish Khan) and remains fully operational.

ZHIM Cooling.note: ZHIM Cooling operates as an independent commercial refrigeration equipment manufacturer and there is no record of an acquisition.
